svg.aria-label: Schematic of ArqueoGal as one red giant's path: its TESS light curve gives oscillations (task 2) and, with PARAM, mass and age (task 4); its Gaia astrometry gives an orbit (task 3); its spectrum gives chemistry, from APOGEE where it exists and from the network JANUS otherwise (task 3). The three fill one row of the all-sky catalogue; Starfold returns the population (task 5); the Galactic model reads the catalogue and draws the disc (task 6). Stages filled in the accent are the ones Andreas Neitzel built, the hatched stage is one he takes part in, outlined stages are the team's. A timeline carries the deliverables from February 2026 to August 2027.

g.text: ONE RED GIANT, THROUGH THE PROJECT
FCT exploratory project 2024.15303.PEX, 18 months · task 1 data management and task 7 outreach alongside
